# PR titles commitlint must reject: "<rule> <title>". Each title has one defect.
# Wrong type, and the type in the wrong case.
[type-enum] feature(storage): add a chart
[type-enum] style(storage): add a chart
[type-case] Feat(storage): add a chart
# Unknown scope, and missing scope.
[scope-enum] feat(lakehouse): add a chart
[scope-empty] feat: add a chart
# Uppercase summary, including a proper noun first (ADR-0007: starts lowercase).
[subject-case] feat(storage): Add a chart
[subject-case] feat(storage): SeaweedFS wrapper chart
# Trailing period.
[subject-full-stop] feat(storage): add a chart.
# `!` in the wrong place.
[type-empty] feat!(storage): add a chart
[type-empty] feat(storage) !: add a chart
# Malformed header: no space or two spaces after the colon, no colon, no type.
[type-empty] feat(storage):add a chart
[type-empty] feat(storage):  add a chart
[type-empty] feat(storage)  add a chart
[type-empty] add a chart
# Summary starting with a digit or punctuation (ADR-0007: starts with a
# lowercase letter).
[type-empty] feat(storage): 2 charts for the catalog
[type-empty] feat(ci): -add x
[type-empty] feat(ci): _add x
[type-empty] feat(ci): "add" x
# commitlint's default ignores are off: git's merge, revert, fixup! and
# squash! messages are not exempt.
[type-empty] Revert "feat(ci): x"
[type-empty] Merge branch 'main' into feat/1-x
[type-empty] fixup! feat(ci): add x
[type-empty] squash! feat(ci): add x
# A bare version, which commitlint would also skip by default.
[type-empty] v1.2.3
# Leading whitespace, and an empty summary.
[header-trim]  feat(storage): add a chart
[subject-empty] feat(storage):
